notes.attention: R3 (2026-10-29): the two old Desk shapes — a question_asked carrying a bare message, an approval_requested with no request map and nothing parked beside it (old_shape_question, old_shape_approval) — fold to the kind on the server and to none on the holder, whose local parked state is the truth for a held row. The server's reading is a guess about history, not a contract, and stays pending. No open row depends on it: on 2026-10-29 production had no open row waiting on an ask in either shape (two waited on a question, both the current shape).
notes.attention_line: The server's alone. R2 (2026-10-29): the window never computes one — it draws the parked question itself, and a row it does not hold shows the lobby's line — and Phase 2's feed row carries it from the server. Checked by the Elixir suite only; the Desk's check covers the other ten. Ruling 4 of the evaluation (holder row later) will revisit it when the holder publishes its row summary.
notes.pr_opened: A pr_opened with no number is not fixturable: the server's door refuses it (Event's validate_pull_request), so no server stream holds one. The Desk's rule for it — a pull request nobody can name moves nothing — matters only to a copy a lobby older than 7d minted.
notes.turns: Turn starts plus reverts: the number the next checkpoint takes, less one. Never "turns completed": a turn in flight has already taken its number. R1 (2026-10-29): the server adopted the Desk's count; before it the server counted ends and ignored checkpoint_reverted.
notes.working: A turn started and not ended, nor its agent gone since. R4 (2026-10-29): the server adopted the Desk's reading — an agent_gone, any code, ends the work (agent_gone_mid_turn), turns unchanged, and the next turn_started starts it again; before it the server's working stayed true until a turn's end landed. R5 (2026-10-29): the Desk adopted the server's — an agent_opened after the death does not resume the turn it left open (agent_gone_then_agent_opened), since nothing re-sends the prompt it took; before it the Desk kept the turn's clock through the death and read working off the agent being up again.
